summary: Slider's keyboard focus ring was declared and never painted. Base UI focuses the native input[type=range] INSIDE the thumb, never the thumb div, so `focus-visible:shadow-(--ui-focus-ring)` on the div matched nothing — every gate was green because the class resolved and the token existed, and no test had ever focused a slider and looked. The thumb now keys off `has-focus-visible:` (and so does the forced-colors outline), keeping --ui-shadow-sm beneath the ring as the sheet draws it. The same mistake hid the disabled ring: `disabled:` on a div never matches, so it now keys off Base UI's data-disabled. The group also carries aria-disabled when disabled, so its label and value read as parts of a disabled control rather than as low-contrast text. Probed: the browser test fails against the shipped class with no focus colour in the computed shadow. Paper: https://app.paper.design/file/01KZ39A2BC286MT85M658NRR4R/p-Z-0 (Component --- Slider --- Revision / Variants / Dark / API, Behaviour, Tokens, Gaps). Consumers with a copied slider.tsx should take the thumb class.
